name: Gauntlets of the Skilled Maneuver
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 235
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd
Slot hands; Price 4,000 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
The wearer of these gauntlets gains a +2 bonus on one type of combat maneuver check (such as bull rush, disarm, or steal) chosen by the creator when the item is created.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, creator must have the appropriate Improved combat maneuver feat; Cost 2,000 gp
